change: Replaced secondary 'mid back' (Rhomboids + Upper Traps) with 'biceps' (Biceps Brachii) and 'Triceps' (Triceps Brachii). At fast speed the push-pull arm drive actively and heavily recruits biceps (on pull) and triceps (on push) as confirmed by multiple sources describing the assault bike arm mechanics. Mid back stabilizers are less dominant than the actively contracting elbow flexors/extensors at high intensity. This brings the exercise in line with assault_airbike_normal_speed which already included biceps and Triceps.
